personality.source: Persian items from the Alheimsins b5-johnson-120-ipip-neo-pi-r repository, data/fa/questions.json (commit 493546d, 2024-04-19; https://github.com/Alheimsins/b5-johnson-120-ipip-neo-pi-r, MIT), matched to our items by English text. Translator not credited in that repository. 11 items corrected by us (see notes). Instructions and scale labels translated by us.
personality.notes: No published, psychometrically validated Persian IPIP-NEO-120 exists as far as we could find. The Alheimsins Persian set is a volunteer, unvalidated translation (no back-translation or psychometric study reported). Spacing/ZWNJ and spelling normalised (e.g. می‌, سوءاستفاده, موزه‌های). US norms (norms-ipip-neo-120.json) are applied as-is; no Persian norms exist. Items corrected from the source: P012 'Take charge': source "مسئولیت‌پذیر هستم" means "I am responsible" (wrong facet: Assertiveness, not Dutifulness) | P013 'Experience my emotions intensely': source said "completely" (کاملا) instead of "intensely" | P019 'Love a good fight': source "مبارزه" reads as combat/struggle; item means quarrel/conflict | P024 'Believe that I am better than others': typo in source (کعتقدم) | P054 'Think highly of myself': source "خیلی به خودم فکر می‌کنم" means "I think about myself a lot" | P056 'Become overwhelmed by events': source "غرقِ در حوادث می‌شوم" is unidiomatic/literal | P084 'Have a high opinion of myself': source "به خودم احترام می‌گذارم" means "I respect myself" (desirable self-respect, not immodesty; would distort a reverse-keyed Modesty item) | P100 'Leave my belongings around': source "وسایلم را جا می‌گذارم" means "I forget/leave my things behind somewhere" | P107 'Like to take it easy': source "سخت نمی‌گیرم" means "I am easygoing/lenient"; Activity Level item means relaxed pace | P109 'Get back at others': source idiom "حق کسی را کف دستش گذاشتن" can mean a deserved rebuke; item means retaliation | P114 'Boast about my virtues': source "با افتخار ... حرف می‌زنم" softens "boast". Source item kept but worth review: P021 "Go on binges" = "پرخوری می‌کنم" (narrows binges to overeating). Scale: Alheimsins uses agree/disagree labels (کاملا مخالفم ... کاملا موافقم); we use accuracy labels to match the original Very Inaccurate ... Very Accurate anchors.
personality.instructions: خودتان را همان‌طور که در حال حاضر به‌طور معمول هستید توصیف کنید، نه آن‌طور که دوست دارید در آینده باشید. خودتان را همان‌طور که صادقانه می‌بینید، در مقایسه با افراد هم‌جنس و تقریباً هم‌سن خودتان که می‌شناسید، توصیف کنید. هر جمله را با دقت بخوانید و گزینه‌ای را انتخاب کنید که بهتر از همه شما را توصیف می‌کند.

interests.source: Translated into Persian by us (Claude) from the English O*NET Interest Profiler Short Form items (USDOL/ETA, CC BY 4.0). No published Persian translation of the O*NET Interest Profiler was found. Changes from the original: translated into Persian.
interests.notes: Machine-authored translation, not back-translated or psychometrically tested; US-based scoring/norms. Items are rendered as Persian verbal-noun phrases (e.g. "ساختن کابینت آشپزخانه"), the usual format for Persian interest inventories, mirroring the English activity phrases. Required CC BY credit must state the items were translated. Cultural notes: I005 stocks and bonds (سهام و اوراق قرضه), I033 jazz or tap dance (رقص جاز یا تپ) and I037 fish hatchery are kept literal; I024 hand-held computer (رایانه‌ی دستی) is dated but literal.
interests.instructions: هر فعالیت کاری را بخوانید و مشخص کنید که چقدر از انجام آن لذت می‌برید. نگران این نباشید که تحصیلات یا آموزش لازم را دارید یا نه، یا چقدر درآمد خواهید داشت. فقط به این فکر کنید که آیا خودِ آن کار را دوست دارید یا نه.
